user.title: Set up Yahoo Fantasy Football
user.description: Enter your league id, or paste the full address of your league page — the id is the number in the URL. Leave the display name blank to use the league's own name. This integration uses Yahoo's anonymous GameChannel feed; availability depends on Yahoo permitting anonymous access.

team.title: Which team is yours?
team.description: Pick your team in {league} to get a sensor for your own matchup. Choose none for the league scoreboard only.

error.invalid_league_id: No league id found. Enter the number from your league URL, or paste the whole address.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Yahoo, or that league id returned nothing. Check the id and try again.
error.yahoo_access_denied: Yahoo refused access to its league data (HTTP 401/403). Yahoo may require a session cookie or sign-in that this integration does not currently support. Check the project's troubleshooting notes for updates; re-entering the same league id or reinstalling is unlikely to help.
